{{Top|leg}}
'''SenateOS''' was a type of [[Computer/Legends|computer]] system located at the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]<ref name="Encounter">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Vandals at the Gate|[[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]}}</ref> by [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{DynamicDate|Vandals at the Gate|Coruscant}}</ref> The system was capable of acquiring remote access protocol and performing a factory reset.<ref name="Encounter" />

==Behind the scenes==
SenateOS appears in the dynamic encounter mission "Vandals at the Gate" in the malfunctioning terminal<ref name="Encounter" /> introduced in Game Update 7.7: ''Dynamic Worlds'', released on [[May 28]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Dynamic Worlds">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20250528-1|text=Game Update 7.7 "Dynamic Worlds" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
